snippet.title: Is THIS the THIERRY HENRY We Waited YEARS For? 👑 PACK OPENING x GAMEPLAY x REVIEW 🔥
snippet.description:
Big Time Thierry Henry is finally in eFootball 27, but does he play like the striker we waited years for? 👑 I open the 250-player Big Time & Epic Arsenal FC pack and test all six Arsenal legends in Division matches with a full Arsenal squad.

Henry has Momentum Dribbling, Acceleration Burst and Blitz Curler. That sounds like the Henry we remember: pick it up on the left, burst past the defender and bend it into the far corner. But before any of that can happen, he has to make the run. That’s what I wanted to find out in this review: did Konami get his playstyle right?

Then there’s Sol Campbell. If you played PES, you know why nobody wanted to face him. Now he’s back with Shadow Hunt and Power Tackle. Henry is the reason I wanted to open this pack, but could Campbell be the best reason to spend your coins?

I also test Dennis Bergkamp’s Phenomenal Pass and Magnetic Feet alongside Emmanuel Petit, Giovanni van Bronckhorst and David Seaman. From Seaman in goal to Henry up front, all six get their chance in Division gameplay before my final verdict on the Arsenal pack.

If this review helps you decide whether to spin or save your coins, leave a like and subscribe to my channel for more eFootball 27 player reviews. And tell me in the comments: if you could take just ONE player from this box, would it be Henry, Campbell or someone else? 👇
